column2: [intro]
I've decided to take the big leap,
Drown my fears, break the tight grip.
I want to live unencumbered,
By all these barriers to be surrendered.
I set fire to my routines,
Weave my web in the unknown scenes.
No limits, I'm bursting with energy,
I'm ready to live my life carefree.
All these doubts that paralyze me,
I chase them away, put them in history.
I give myself the chance to bloom,
In this world that loves to consume.
